meta.title: SportsDesk desk
meta.description: Adds a SportsDesk entry to the left sidebar; it opens a read-only desk overview that measures the local SportsDesk webview service from five same-origin routes: service state (/health, /api/status), market feed and repo evidence (/api/graph/summary), book KPIs with provenance (/api/kpis) and the paper execution plan (/api/execution/plan). Each source is probed independently, so a failed or missing source is named instead of zeroed, and a payload that previously loaded stays visible labelled stale.
